definitions.scope: all kv_snapshot rows, one series per (pool_tag, group_id)
definitions.per_shard: each worker's own binned step series (the plot's faint 'shadow' lines)
definitions.aggregate: across-shard mean / min / max per time bin (the standout lines); a wide min↔max band = shard imbalance
definitions.active_tokens: resident/committed KV — the CURRENT occupancy, including retained prefix-cache entries
definitions.retained_prefix_tokens: prefix-cache component captured at the same raw submit that set the active_kv throttle-window peak; active - retained_prefix is non-prefix active KV
definitions.has_retained_prefix_breakdown: false for old kv_snapshot logs without the retained_prefix_kv column; their compatibility series is zero-filled and must not be interpreted as a measured zero
definitions.projected_tokens: admission gate's FUTURE estimate (each admitted request's full decode horizon); may exceed capacity
definitions.promised_tokens: reserved-but-not-resident KV footprint (admitted, not yet realized)
definitions.capacity_tokens: static per-shard KV token budget from run_meta.json kv_pools; null when KV logging carries no capacity
definitions.fraction: tokens / capacity_tokens (percent on the plot); projected is intentionally not clamped to 100%
definitions.peak_active_max_pct: worst individual shard's peak — the imbalance-aware headroom
definitions.bin: one equal-width time segment (200 bins over the run span)
